bibliographic.title: Homeland
bibliographic.author: Jason Self
bibliographic.description: In this introduction to a game, you play as a homeowner whose morning is disturbed by a yet another small explosion next door. Meanwhile, a TV news report informs you that as many as five people are missing. You don't know anything about that, but you can at least find out what your neighbour's up to.
